editions.subject: Japan Launches Fable Alternative — EU Blocks It
editions.body_excerpt:
• Sakana introduces Fugu, a flexible AI system with no European access
• Nobel laureate Jumper leaves Google DeepMind for Anthropic
• GLM-5.2 revoluti[![Japan Launches Fable Alternative — EU Blocks It](https://lbrzdn804nhy3kox.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/post-images/57c67298-c41a-4ecd-9fcd-9dbaf3dc972a/2d0c53a8-ad55-41df-8404-d8323cfc3d79-cover-email.png)](https://www.synthszr.com/en/posts/japan-launcht-fable-alternative-eu-blockiert-sie?autoplay=true&sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94)[![Listen on Apple Podcasts and Spotify](https://www.synthszr.com/api/newsletter/promo-block?v=4)](https://www.synthszr.com/en/posts/japan-launcht-fable-alternative-eu-blockiert-sie?autoplay=true&sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94)Update from Tuesday, June 23, 2026Japan Launches Fable Alternative — EU Blocks It• Sakana introduces Fugu, a flexible AI system with no European access• Nobel laureate Jumper leaves Google DeepMind for Anthropic• GLM-5.2 revolutionizes open source with impressive market performance

 
 ![](https://www.synthszr.com/api/newsletter/thumbnail-image?url=https%3A%2F%2Flbrzdn804nhy3kox.public.blob.vercel-storage.com%2Fpost-images%2F57c67298-c41a-4ecd-9fcd-9dbaf3dc972a%2Fthumbnail-0-a5eb5574-4756-4648-a676-54b96320e1ac.png&bg=00FF00) 
 
 ![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=venturebeat.com&sz=32) [Japan Counters Claude Mythos with Fugu — But Without Europe](https://venturebeat.com/orchestration/no-claude-fable-5-no-problem-sakana-achieves-frontier-performance-with-new-fugu-multi-model-auto-synthesis-system)
Sakana, the increasingly enterprise-focused AI startup from ex-[Google](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/google?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94) Brain's David Ha, launched Fugu last night: a multi-agent orchestration system that delivers frontier performance through a single, [OpenAI](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/OpenAI?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94)-compatible API. Instead of relying on a single monolithic model, Fugu (Japanese for pufferfish) dynamically routes requests to an interchangeable pool of specialized agents. The timing is no coincidence: On June 12, following a U.S. export control order, [Anthropic](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/Anthropic?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94) cut off public access to its top models, Claude Mythos 5 and Fable 5. Fugu surpasses them on benchmarks: 93.2 on LiveCodeBench versus Fable's 89.8 and 95.5 on GPQA-Diamond. The prices are steep: Fugu Ultra starts at $5 per million input tokens and $30 per million output tokens. The catch: Which models Fugu chooses internally remains proprietary and hidden from the user, and in the EU, the service isn't running at all for now due to open GDPR questions. 

 
 
 
 ![SYNTHSZR PODCAST Tuesday, June 23](https://www.synthszr.com/api/newsletter/podcast-promo-text?headline=SYNTHSZR%20PODCAST%20Tuesday%2C%20June%2023&title=Japan%20Fires%20Back%3A%20Fugu%20vs.%20Claude%2C%20Nobel%20Prize%20Defection&subtitle=Japan%20launches%20Fable%20alternative%20as%20EU%20blocks%20Claude%2C%20while%20Nobel%20laureate%20jumps%20to%20Anthropic) 
 
 [![Apple Podcasts](https://www.synthszr.com/podcast-apple-button.png)](https://podcasts.apple.com/de/podcast/synthszr/id1879733990)
 [![Spotify](https://www.synthszr.com/podcast-spotify-button.png)](https://open.spotify.com/show/0FJkPjKXvobgqI8U881yiF?si=wMJJ-CQxQdyuW18VXQZQOQ)
 
 
 

Synthszr Take: On June 12, [Anthropic](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/Anthropic?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94) shut down Claude Mythos 5 and Fable 5 outside the US. Three days later, a system arrives from Tokyo that surpasses them on benchmarks. This should make us in Europe think, and for the right reason. Sakana has delivered what [Mistral](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/mistral?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94) & Co couldn't. We talk about sovereignty, found consortia, write strategy papers. David Ha read the export order and built a finished product to fill the gap. Fugu scores 93.2 on LiveCodeBench versus Fable's 89.8. This isn't an announcement. It's live. And what does the EU do? It blocks the service. Open GDPR questions, Fugu isn't launching in Europe for now. We just witnessed live how quickly a US provider can turn off the tap. In the same moment, a friendly nation delivers the first real alternative, and Brussels turns it away at the border. Japan and Europe are in the same boat. Both depend on US models, neither has its own frontier stack, and both are watching the race between Washington and Beijing from the sidelines. The logical next move is clear: call instead of [block](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/block?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94). Common standards, a common market, a second pole not based in California. A smart alliance with Sakana would be the first real move Europe has made in this game. Fugu is no saint here. The routing logic remains a black [box](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/box?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94), the user doesn't see which model is working on their request, and $30 per million output tokens is steep for a layer that only coordinates. Sakana protects itself from vendor lock-in by becoming a gatekeeper itself. This is exactly what needs to be negotiated. But you can only negotiate if you're at the table. If you want sovereignty, you have to want it even when it's inconvenient. Otherwise, Europe will remain the market that watches others build the infrastructure it will depend on tomorrow.

 ![](https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=daily.therundown.ai&sz=32) [Google's Talent Exodus: A Nobel Laureate Goes to Anthropic](https://daily.therundown.ai/)
John Jumper is leaving [Google](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/google?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94) DeepMind after nine years to join [Anthropic](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/Anthropic?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94). Jumper co-developed AlphaFold, the AI for predicting protein structures, and received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for it along with Demis Hassabis. His departure comes just days after Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer moved to [OpenAI](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/OpenAI?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94), marking two prominent minds leaving in a single week. Jumper plans to “take a break” before starting at Anthropic, just in time for a science event scheduled for June 30. He reportedly also recently worked on coding tools for the enterprise sector at Google, a field where the company lags behind its frontier rivals. After Google's models led the pack in 2024 and 2025, 2026 feels like a step back compared to OpenAI and Anthropic. Science was considered DeepMind's home turf, and that's exactly where there's now a gap. 
Synthszr Take: Talent is the real moat in the AI business, and [Google](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/google?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94) is currently losing it to the two companies it's competing against. Jumper isn't just any researcher; with AlphaFold, he delivered the one flagship project that elevated DeepMind beyond mere language models. The fact that he's going to [Anthropic](https://www.synthszr.com/en/companies/Anthropic?sid=f351fd30-5cc2-4ce0-8a74-9e04c82e8e94), whose revenue we saw heading toward $20 billion in early March, says more about the gravitational pull of valuations than about Google itself. A corporation with this research depth can replicate models, but it can't pull a second Nobel laureate off the shelf. The sober question for Sundar Pichai is why the best minds prefer stock packages from a highly valued startup over the security of a trillion-dollar corporation. Anyone who answers with just more compute and more salary hasn't understood the question.
